The Systemic Problem

The Administrative Crisis Paralyzing Wards & GPs

Clinicians spend hours wrestling with fragmented records while patients leave hospitals confused and vulnerable.

🏥 Inpatient Wards (Secondary Care)
45–60 min
Per discharge notification
  • Junior doctors spend 2.5 hours overtime daily dredging physical notes and lab portals.
  • Patients wait 4–6 hours for TTO meds, bed-blocking while ambulances queue at A&E.
  • 50% of hospital medication errors occur during discharge handover.
🩺 General Practice (Primary Care)
10 Minutes
Total GP consultation window
  • Multimorbid patients have 15+ years of fragmented EMIS Web / SystmOne consultation text.
  • GPs cannot review overdue diabetic foot checks or urine ACR tests before the patient walks in.
  • Unmonitored drug combinations cause dangerous anticholinergic cognitive burdens.
👤 The Vulnerable Patient
1 in 5
Readmitted within 30 days
  • Discharge letters are written in Latinate medical jargon (Reading Level 12+).
  • Patients don't understand which home pills were stopped vs continued.
  • Lack of clear safety-netting leads to avoidable emergency readmissions.
Data source: NHS England Emergency Care Delivery Group & British Medical Association Workload Survey
Strategic Breakthrough

Why Ambient Audio Scribes Cannot Solve Inpatient Care

Bedside ambient recording captures single conversations. Inpatient and longitudinal care require multi-source synthesis.

The Single-Encounter Paradigm (Ambient Scribing)
Ambient Consultation Scribing
  • Listens to a single 15-minute doctor-patient dialogue in real-time.
  • Fatal limitation: Inpatient care spans 7 to 21 days with 40+ clinicians, nurses, and allied health staff.
  • Fails to capture overnight nurse handover logs, vitals observations, and blood test curves.
  • Cannot cross-reference historical pre-admission medications or PACS radiology imaging.
Verdict: Excellent for outpatient clinics, fundamentally incapable of solving the inpatient discharge bottleneck.
The Asynchronous Synthesis Paradigm (Tandem OS)
Autonomous Longitudinal Record Synthesis
  • Asynchronously ingests EHR ward rounds, nursing charts, pathology labs, and PACS scans.
  • Reconciles pre-admission medications against inpatient TTO changes with deterministic 4-state logic.
  • Generates dual outputs: formal PRSB-compliant doctor notes AND plain-English patient leaflets.
  • 100% Extractive Grounding: every generated sentence links directly to raw timeline citations.
Verdict: Unlocks the full clinical episode loop across primary and secondary care.
Tandem Health expands from real-time ambient listening into comprehensive clinical synthesis.

Clinician Impact & Patient Safety

Eliminating Medication Errors: The 4-State Med Rec Matrix

Discharge prescription errors harm patients and create severe malpractice liabilities. Tandem enforces strict state logic.

STARTED
New Therapies

Requires mandatory clinical indication and course duration (e.g. Clarithromycin 500mg BD — 5 day course for RLL pneumonia).

Prevents indefinite antibiotic courses
STOPPED
Discontinued Drugs

Mandates explicit rationale so GPs never restart nephrotoxic drugs (e.g. Ramipril 5mg OD withheld due to Stage 1 AKI).

Prevents inadvertent GP repeat issues
DOSE CHANGED
Titrated Therapies

Flags titration steps and primary care blood test requirements (e.g. Furosemide doubled to 80mg OD; GP U&E check in 7 days).

Protects electrolyte & renal balance
CONTINUED
Chronic Baselines

Cross-checks all pre-admission repeat medications against inpatient records to verify zero accidental omissions.

Zero unmonitored drop-offs
Every medication change includes dm+d dictionary coding and links directly to timeline evidence citations.
Patient Dignity & Health Equity

Protecting Patients at Home: Jargon-Free Guidance

Patients cannot follow care plans they cannot read. Tandem translates medical records into plain English.

📖 Reading Age 11 Translation

Calibrated to Flesch-Kincaid Grade ≤ 6. Translates intimidating doctor jargon:

"Patient sustained acute non-ST elevation MI with mild subhepatic collection."
"You had a heart incident and a small fluid pocket after your gallbladder surgery that has now settled."

Restores understanding and calms post-discharge patient anxiety.

💊 Visual Medication Schedule

Eliminates medication confusion with intuitive time-of-day blocks:

Morning: Blood pressure tablet
Lunch: Antibiotic capsule
Dinner: Pain relief tablet
Bedtime: Cholesterol tablet

Explains exactly which pills were changed and why.

🚨 111 vs 999 Red Flag Safety Net

Empowers patients with life-saving decision rules:

Call 111 / GP if: Weight increases by >1.5kg or mild swelling returns in ankles.
Dial 999 immediately if: Sudden severe chest pain or blue lips occur.

Reduces unnecessary 999 panics while preventing delayed critical care.

Validated by clinical communicators to ensure compliance with NHS Accessible Information Standards.
Trust & Clinical Safety

Zero-Hallucination Architecture & 1-Click Citations

Doctors cannot trust unverified generative AI. Tandem provides mathematical proof of provenance for every sentence.

🔗 1-Click Interactive Citations

Every assertion in the synthesized note contains a clickable evidence link (e.g. Ref #t1-wr3). Clicking it scrolls directly to the raw ward round note and highlights the source sentence.

100% Extractive Grounding • Zero Confabulation
⚠️ Clinical Contradiction & Audit Comments Log

Interceps System Errors (HL7 52-min latency, tube hemolysis), Human Slips (allergy omission, copy-paste) & AI Hallucinations (ungrounded diabetes draft). Generates signed audit log with doctor comments. Timeline automatically unflags once fixed.

Immutable Audit Trail • Dynamic Timeline Unflagging
🛡️ DCB0129 / DCB0160 Governance

Adheres strictly to NHS Clinical Safety Standards. The AI functions solely as a drafting co-pilot. Every section is fully editable, and requires formal clinician confirmation before dispatch.

Human-in-the-Loop Sovereign Gate
Fully synthetic, anonymized test cases complying with UK Data Protection Act 2018 and Caldicott Principles.

Diagnostic Suite

Multi-Modality PACS Imaging Integration

10 authentic diagnostic investigations cross-linked into patient timelines with full-screen lightbox magnification.

Primary Care Investigations (GP Cases)
  • Retinal Fundus Photography: NHS Diabetic Eye Screening (OS) showing background retinopathy microaneurysms.
  • Continuous Glucose Monitoring (CGM): 24-hour Ambulatory Glucose Profile with 52% TIR and post-prandial spikes.
  • 12-Lead Diagnostic ECG: High-resolution rhythm strip confirming sinus rhythm with prolonged PR and borderline QTc.
  • Non-Contrast Axial Head CT: Post-fall neurological workup excluding acute intracranial hemorrhage.
Secondary Care Investigations (Acute Wards)
  • Bedside Echocardiogram: Apical 4-chamber ultrasound showing severe LV systolic impairment (EF 28–35%).
  • Portable Chest Radiograph: Erect AP film demonstrating cardiomegaly and alveolar pulmonary edema.
  • Erect PA Chest Radiograph: Dense right lower lobe pneumonia consolidation in severe asthma exacerbation.
  • Spirometry Flow-Volume Loop: Obstructive curve showing FEV1/FVC 0.58 with 18% bronchodilator reversibility.
  • Abdominal Ultrasound & CT: Gallbladder bed collection caliper tracing & cystic duct anatomy.
Clinicians can inspect radiological images directly inside the timeline with verified PACS metadata.
